title: Migrate unit tests from XCTest to Swift Testing
description:
Our unit suite is on XCTest — verbose, class-based, and awkward with async code. We're moving to Swift Testing for:

  • Parallelism — tests run in parallel out of the box.
  • Simpler syntax — #expect / #require and @Test instead of XCTAssert boilerplate.
  • First-class async/await — no expectation-and-wait dance.
  • @TaskLocal support — pairs cleanly with Swift Dependencies for per-test mocks.
  • Parametrized tests — one @Test with many cases instead of copy-pasted methods.
